blocks.text: Banda sends letters across the land calling the Sikhs to assemble against the killers of the Sahibzadas and the enemies of the Guru’s house.
At the same time the Guru and Khalsa insist on a limit: if Banda seeks sovereignty apart from the Khalsa, he will lose the blessing that now sustains him.
The page joins militancy with discipline, making early Banda power conditional on obedience to the Khalsa rather than on private kingship.
